name: current-base-deterministic-mock-required-messaging-002-api67
salesforceExclusionReason: Messaging DTO and email-result shapes are covered as deterministic local mocks; this fixture does not claim hosted email delivery or Salesforce compile parity.
notes: Current-base Messaging-002 lane: result object identity methods, email header/property boundaries, text attachments, and System.Messaging aliases are exercised locally without live delivery claims.

source.content: @isTest private class CurrentBaseMessagingDeterministic002Test { @isTest static void resultAndAttachmentShapes() { Messaging.SingleEmailMessage invalid = new Messaging.SingleEmailMessage(); invalid.setToAddresses(new List<String>{'missing-body@example.test'}); List<Messaging.SendEmailResult> results = Messaging.sendEmail(new List<Messaging.SingleEmailMessage>{invalid}, false); Messaging.SendEmailResult result = results[0]; System.assertEquals(false, result.isSuccess()); System.assertEquals(true, result.equals(result)); System.assertNotEquals(null, result.hashCode()); System.assertNotEquals(null, result.toString()); Messaging.SendEmailError error = result.getErrors()[0]; System.assertEquals(true, error.equals(error)); System.assertNotEquals(null, error.hashCode()); System.assertNotEquals(null, error.toString()); Messaging.SingleEmailMessage single = new Messaging.SingleEmailMessage(); single.setCustomHeaders(new Map<String,String>{'X-Trace' => 'local'}); System.assertEquals('local', single.getCustomHeaders().get('X-Trace')); System.assertEquals(null, single.templatename); System.assertEquals(false, single.usermail); Messaging.TextAttachment text = new Messaging.TextAttachment(); text.body = 'text body'; text.bodyIsTruncated = false; text.charset = 'UTF-8'; text.fileName = 'note.txt'; text.headers = new List<Messaging.Header>(); text.mimeTypeSubType = 'text/plain'; System.assertNotEquals(null, text.clone()); System.assertEquals('text body', text.body); System.assertEquals(false, text.bodyIsTruncated); System.assertEquals('UTF-8', text.charset); System.assertEquals('note.txt', text.fileName); System.assertEquals('text/plain', text.mimeTypeSubType); Messaging.MassEmailMessage mass = new Messaging.MassEmailMessage(); System.assertNotEquals(null, mass); } }
